items.title: Investigating the Aging Behavior of Asphalt Binders at Different Production Stages and During the Service Life of the Pavement
items.authors: Mohamed Elkashef, Debakanta Deb Mishra, Sina Mousavi Rad, Michael Olagunju, Mehdi Sadeghi, & Adeoluwa Gbolade
items.venue: U.S. Department of Transportation, National Transportation Library
items.abstract: This report evaluates cracking, rutting, moisture susceptibility, compaction, and binder rheology for 36 Oklahoma asphalt mixtures, including the effects of long-term aging and machine-learning prediction of cracking tolerance.
